title: Smart Data Models - ERA EVR - VehicleRegistration
description:
Vehicle Registration (era:VehicleRegistration's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Vehicle Registration serves to ensure traceability of vehicles and their history: vehicles should be registered under a European vehicle number in a vehicle register. Each
member state designated a registration entity responsible for the registering of vehicles and the processing and update of information in relation to vehicles that entity has registered in the European Vehicle Register.

A vehicle registration groups the information for a (set of) vehicle(s) as in Appendix 4 of Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2018/1614 of 25 October 2018. Inherits attributes from era:Permission (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VehicleRegistration'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

permissionStatus.description: Property. the status of the Permission, from a controlled Vocabulary, expressing how it evolves from being drafted to being valid and eventually possibly revoked/withdrawn. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

permits.description: Property. the process, activity, role or other scope which the Permission allows to the Requesting Body to execute or hold Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

requestedIn.description: Relationship. aiming to be enabled to act as covered by the Permission and its conditions, by issuing Target type (Request) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

submittedIn.description: Relationship. The submission of a permission or evidence to a case Target type (Case) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

valid.description: Relationship. valid during a certain time Target type (Interval) is not published as its own SDM model yet.
